steps.title: Open the Desk
steps.narration: The Playbook Signals hub loads, bringing together the Rapid Microscope's core research surface. This iteration unveils new materialized data and structure-aware candidate anchors.
steps.point_out: The 'Playbook Signals' heading and fully-rendered page confirm the frontend is connected.

steps.title: Expand Microscope Readiness
steps.narration: The Microscope Readiness section opens to show corpus statistics. A new row appears this iteration: the materialized band-touch count, showing how many times the dataset's trades touched recorded price walls.
steps.point_out: The 'Joinable corpus — band touches' row now displays a real enumerated count (not a placeholder), immediately below the 'withheld (excluded)' row.

steps.title: Review Scout Ledger (before pilot trigger)
steps.narration: The Scout Ledger section shows the ledger of screened candidates. On a fresh backend with no pilot-grid run yet, it displays the 'No candidates ledgered' state — the honest empty state before any structured research begins.
steps.point_out: Scout Ledger expands and shows 'No candidates ledgered' and the ledger chain verification status.

steps.title: Expand Walk-Forward section
steps.narration: The Walk-Forward section displays fold specifications and floor-check decisions. Like Scout Ledger on a fresh backend, it shows the empty state before pilot-grid results are recorded.
steps.point_out: Walk-Forward section expands, showing no fold specs or results yet on this clean backend.

steps.title: View Validation Vault
steps.narration: The Validation Vault section displays the registered dataset universe and its shards. This section remains stable and unchanged from prior iterations.
steps.point_out: The Validation Vault section shows the registered test universe and any shards within it.

steps.title: Expand Playbook Evidence section
steps.narration: Playbook Evidence shows any recorded playbook signals for a given date. Enter a date to see the evidence of recorded signals for that trading day.
steps.point_out: Playbook Evidence section header is visible with a date input field.

steps.title: Enter a date to view playbook signals
steps.narration: Fill in the date field with a known trading date from the seeded fixture data to reveal any recorded playbook signals for that day.
steps.point_out: After filling the date, the 'recorded signals, none hidden' message confirms the query completed and the result is shown honestly.

steps.title: Confirm Referee Registry shows current configuration
steps.narration: The Referee Registry section displays the configuration fingerprint and any registered referee rules. It remains unchanged and frozen this iteration.
steps.point_out: Referee Registry section opens and shows the configuration fingerprint '08e471b10130e1e2', confirming this iteration's stable, audited state.
